cacRoot requests the hashed native root directly; otherwise chooses three-argument storagegetbuffer when arg2 is nonnil or the two-argument version. Returns the requested root/buffer. Weapon0 calls ClearDisplay then returns. Otherwise requests paintjob setup and a CustomClass_update local-client notify carrying the shown slot, converted weapon, empty attachments, camera and options fields. No network/persistence result is proved. Sends CustomClass_remove plus adjusted local-client number with an empty payload; no local cleanup completion is asserted. Returns editorMode != none from GetEmblemEditorProperties. Ends native edits; chooses paintshop/emblem customization and model notify; clears four per-controller selection fields; sets editor/color none and clipboard EMPTY; requests profile commit, optional paintjob invalidation and grid-size0. No rollback or commit success guard is added. Only uploadProfile==true clears the flag first and requests execnow uploadprofile. No retry/success notification or server implementation is supplied. For a supplied name matching an entitlement record and storage type, returns true at the first owned entitlement, else false for that matching record. No matching record or absent name defaults true. Both numeric loop headers are explicit: start1, step1, outer terminal #CoD.CraftUtility.EmblemEntitlements and inner terminal #f398_local3.entitlementRefs.
